issues.detail: The Greek 'δοκιμην' (dokimen) in this context (John 16:27) refers to 'proof' or 'evidence' of the truth of what Jesus is saying, not a 'thử nghiệm' (test/experiment/trial). Translating it as 'tìm kiếm một thử nghiệm' suggests seeking an experiment or a test to be performed, rather than seeking proof of the words being spoken.
